class_id: optional dependency never injected by the one builder that constructs it
feature: scraper/src/services/filing-persist-deps.ts (and any single dependency builder whose interface marks a collaborator optional)
symptom: a collaborator is declared OPTIONAL on a deps interface (`childRowConsolidator?:`) and the one builder that assembles that interface never sets it, so the feature behind it is wired to nothing: the code type-checks, every call silently takes the degraded fallback branch, and the only evidence is ABSENT DATA downstream (all 8,076 staging `field_sources` rows carrying `row_key = ''`, coverage `UNVERIFIABLE, enforcedPairCount 0`) rather than any error. TypeScript cannot flag a missing optional member, so neither the compiler, nor code review across thirty slices, nor the fallback's own `logger.error` (which the running staging build predated) surfaced it
first_seen: Sep 2026 (F-101, PR #625) - item 1's `consolidatedUpsertChildRows` shipped across thirty slices and had NEVER executed in staging or production, because `buildFilingPersistDeps` was never updated when the member was added to `FilingPersisterDeps`
fix_prs: PR #625 (inject the consolidator in the builder; change the interface member from optional to REQUIRED so the next omission is a compile error; refuse in the builder - not at scraper startup - when the flag is on and the method is absent)
detection_check: not one of the three sanctioned check types (no `SUBSTANCE_CHECKS` key, no `audit-detection-floor.mjs` `record()` id, no `audit-ipo-coverage.mjs` invariant) - guarded by `scraper/tests/unit/services/filing-persist-deps-completeness.test.ts`, which enumerates the members of `interface FilingPersisterDeps` through the TypeScript compiler API (`ts.createSourceFile`, never a hand-typed list) and asserts `buildFilingPersistDeps()` leaves none of them undefined, plus `filing-persist-deps-refusal.test.ts` covering the builder's throw
status: guarded for `FilingPersisterDeps` only; every OTHER deps interface in the repo with an optional member and a single builder is still unguarded, and generalising the enumerating test into a shared helper is the obvious extension - not taken here because it belongs with whoever owns the builder conventions rather than to this fix
